hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // ""' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE 'app/.+/page\.tsx$' && echo "$f" | grep -qv 'page\.test\.tsx' && TEST="${f%page.tsx}page.test.tsx" && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"page.tsx edited (%s) — update the co-located unit test at %s to reflect the new changes."}}\n' "$f" "$TEST" || true; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Checking if page test needs updating...
